svg.title: LLM system blueprint
svg.desc: Pipeline: query, clarification agent, LangGraph orchestrator routing to agentic RAG, NL-to-SQL engine and document Q&A agent; guardrails (RBAC, tenant isolation, prompt-injection, PII); answer; eval harness feeding back into routing and retrieval.
svg.text: the shape of the LLM systems I ship to production
eval feedback → prompt, routing & retrieval tuning
